name: VS. Super Mario Bros.
description: Nintendo's arcade VS. Super Mario Bros. (Vs. System, 1986) as a native game, statically recompiled from your own dump of the board. Optional Super Mario All-Stars graphics and music from your own SNES ROM.
author_notes: Bring your own dump of the VS. Super Mario Bros. board as an iNES .nes file. MAME's suprmrio.zip / suprmrioa.zip also load in the game itself, but cannot be matched by hash here. For the All-Stars graphics and music, choose your own Super Mario All-Stars (USA) ROM in the game's menu.
notes: Digests are of the whole GoodNES files, header included, because the launcher hashes NES files whole. The game itself checks the PRG+CHR data without the header: sha1 b21aa940728ed80c72ee23c251c96e42cc84b2d6 (crc32 98e3c75a) for MAME suprmrio, and 91fa719b4b05adbac0b9d507d2051ed361d1ded4 (crc32 7cff0f84) for suprmrioa / GoodNES [a1]. Dumps with other headers load in the game but will not match here.
